types.name: revenue
types.description: Σ_t Σ_scope share · e^p · Sh (e^p · Occ for occupancy templates)
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: Sales over the period as filed: price times units shipped, or rent on capacity in use for lessors (of a whole sector: a statistical agency's sales survey, such as the Census Monthly Wholesale Trade Survey's sales of merchant wholesalers).

types.name: production
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: Units produced over the period.

types.name: stated_capacity
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Capacity the owner states at the period's end (of a whole sector: an industry survey's capacity count, such as the AHA's staffed beds).

types.name: export_volume
types.combine: the one entity's own value (the subject must be a single entity)
types.definition: Units exported over the period, from customs records: a share of shipments.

types.name: emissions
types.description: log emissions = a_i + log Q^ref + b_i (log Σ Q − log Q^ref); Q^ref = months × Σ_scope w e^(k̂_0), the data-based starting capacity, so a_i is log emissions per unit at the reference output
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: Annual greenhouse-gas emissions reported to EPA, which rise with output; intercept and slope are the first member's.

types.name: satellite_binary
types.combine: averaged over the members (weighted) at the period's last month
types.definition: Whether an image shows activity at the site (heat, plume, vehicles); its probability rises with utilization.

types.name: satellite_index
types.combine: averaged over the members (weighted) at the period's last month
types.definition: A continuous activity reading from images (e.g. thermal intensity), linear in utilization.

types.name: price
types.combine: averaged over the members (weighted) and over the period's months
types.definition: Average transaction price over the period.

types.name: list_price
types.combine: the one entity's own value (the subject must be a single entity)
types.definition: Published list price: the transaction price plus the entity's listing gap.

types.name: raw_inventory
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Raw-material inventory held at the period's end.

types.name: finished_inventory
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Finished-goods inventory held at the period's end (of a whole sector: a statistical agency's stocks survey, such as EIA's crude and product stocks).

types.name: inventory_at_cost
types.description: e^c · G (finished stock valued at unit cost, in dollars)
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Merchandise on hand for resale at the period's end, valued at cost, of a whole sector (the Census Monthly Wholesale Trade Survey's end-of-month inventories of merchant wholesalers): finished stock at unit cost, representative entities included.

types.name: inventory_real
types.description: G (finished stock in the sector's constant-price unit)
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Merchandise on hand at the period's end of a whole sector in constant prices: a statistical agency's inventories at cost deflated by the sector's price index (the Census Monthly Wholesale Trade Survey's inventories of merchant wholesalers, deflated as BEA's real inventories are). Finished stock, representative entities included; unlike inventory_at_cost it does not depend on each entity's unit cost.

types.name: backlog
types.description: B · e^p (total order book in dollars)
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Order book at the period's end, valued at current prices (backlog, remaining performance obligations; of a whole sector: the Census M3 survey's unfilled orders).

types.name: signed_not_commenced
types.description: 12 · B · e^p: annualized rent of leases signed but not yet commenced (scheduled and overdue book), as data-center REITs report it
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Annualized rent of leases signed whose rent has not started, at the period's end.

types.name: rent_churn
types.description: rent lost to leases ending without renewal over the period, as a share of average rent: Σ w e^p Occ / term ÷ (Σ w e^p Occ / months), as lessors report churn (e.g. MRR churn)
types.combine: a ratio of two sums over the period's months and the members
types.definition: Rent lost over the period to leases ending without renewal, as a share of average rent.

types.name: book_to_bill
types.combine: a ratio of two sums over the period's months and the members
types.definition: Net new orders over the period divided by shipments over the period.

types.name: lead_time
types.combine: the one entity's own value (the subject must be a single entity)
types.definition: Lead time quoted for a new order at the period's end, with the source's bias.

types.name: traffic
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: Output sold over the period, e.g. revenue passenger-miles.

types.name: capacity_offered
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: Output offered over the period, e.g. available seat-miles.

types.name: load_factor
types.combine: a ratio of two sums over the period's months and the members
types.definition: Output sold divided by output offered over the period.

types.name: occupancy
types.combine: averaged over the members (weighted) and over the period's months
types.definition: Share of capacity in use, averaged over the period.

types.name: vacancy
types.combine: averaged over the members (weighted) and over the period's months
types.definition: Share of capacity not in use, averaged over the period.

types.name: market_vacancy
types.combine: a ratio of two sums over the period's months and the members
types.definition: Share of a market's capacity not in use over the period, weighted by capacity (a broker's market vacancy; representative entities included).

types.name: capacity_announced
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: New capacity announced over the period (press releases, planning applications, interconnection requests).

types.name: under_construction
types.combine: summed over the members at the period's last month, each at its weight
types.definition: Capacity under construction at the period's end.

types.name: employment
types.description: employment = labor per unit × average monthly output (L29)
types.combine: averaged over the members (weighted) and over the period's months
types.definition: County Business Patterns employment in a census cell (sector, size class, region), net of the tracked entities' employment: the untracked establishments, which the cell's representative entity stands for. Labor per unit (a sector parameter) times output.

types.name: census_shipments
types.combine: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
types.definition: Economic Census shipments of a census cell, net of the tracked entities: the representative entity's sales.

model1_series.combine_text: summed over the period's months and the members, each at its weight
model1_series.definition: Model 1's nowcast of a sector series (production index, capacity utilization, price index, employment), converted to the sector total of all its entities (L15), tracked and representative; utilization and prices are averages.
